purpose: Self-hosted evaluation baselines, not a newly trained Anyanwu model

asr.note: 25-second non-overlapping chunks accommodate the upstream duration limit. Boundary accuracy must be measured. Asset URLs are defined by the pinned library; checkpoint checksums are not independently verified.

tts.publisherLicense: MIT according to model card; retain upstream notices
tts.note: Candidate checkpoint only. Publisher metadata is not an independent training-data or speaker-rights audit. Uses its built-in voice; no user voice-cloning endpoint is exposed. Retains the base model's watermark.

excludedFromCommercialBaseline.k2-fsa/OmniVoice: Code is Apache-2.0, but the model card states pretrained weights are non-commercial.
excludedFromCommercialBaseline.facebook/mms-tts: Non-commercial pretrained weights; no Igbo checkpoint assumed.
